text: I have the children's letters in my bag. Thirty-one letters to the Christ Child. I promised them I would post them.
Don't make a sound. They hear everything. Breathe slowly, like me.
I have never fired a gun in my life. ...Show me once. Once! Good. Go, I'll watch the stairs.
Please, please, we're not like them! We pushed the wardrobe against the stair door, we've been so quiet... is it over? Tell me it's over.
The letters... somebody post the letters.
Help me up... please, I can't feel my arm...
There, by the door! I see it!
Its hands! Its hands are on me!
